# Multiple image

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Multiple images show several images in one section. It arranges the images in a structured layout for easy comparison or visual storytelling. This component enhances the card's visual appeal and content.

## Example

![Example](/img/multiple-image-appcard.png)

## JSON example

```json
{
    "content": {
        "settings": {},
        "body": [
            {
                "type": "image",
                "cur_index": 0,
                "images": [
                    {
                        "image_url": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1425082661705-1834bfd09dca",
                        "alt_text": "img01",
                        "image_index": 0
                    },
                    {
                        "image_url": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1445499348736-29b6cdfc03b9",
                        "alt_text": "img02",
                        "image_index": 1
                    },
                    {
                        "image_url": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1490718687940-0ecadf414600",
                        "alt_text": "img03",
                        "image_index": 2
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```
